primitives.name: Venue Weather Signal
primitives.verbatim_quote: Free data sources (make the engine smarter / product richer) - **Weather:** NWS api.weather.gov (free, Tier-A, US-only) → venue weather signal.
primitives.assumptions: Weather data is temporally synchronized with event scheduling and spatially localized to venue coordinates.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Signal invalid when NWS API is unavailable or data exceeds 1-hour latency.

layer2.mapping: Weather signal is embedded into GSI's narrative layer as a deterministic feature vector for predictive modeling.
layer2.telemetry: Mean absolute error between predicted and observed venue temperature.

primitives.name: Sentiment Narrative Layer
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **News/sentiment (narrative layer):** **GDELT 2.0** (free, no key, tone every 15min) + Wikipedia Pageviews (attention proxy, Tier-A) + Reddit OAuth (internal only).
primitives.assumptions: Narrative signals are aggregated into a time-series vector with 15-minute resolution.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Signal invalid if GDELT or Wikipedia data is stale beyond 30 minutes.

layer2.mapping: Narrative layer is modeled as a probabilistic mixture over topic distributions in GSI's belief space.
layer2.telemetry: KL divergence between predicted and actual event outcome probabilities.

primitives.name: Motion Precision Constraint
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Discipline:** motion = restrained "lock-on" precision (200–300ms), honor `prefers-reduced-motion`; the reticle/galaxy identity carries it.
primitives.assumptions: Motion transitions are bounded by perceptual thresholds and user preference flags.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Motion fails if transition time exceeds 300ms or reduced motion is enabled without fallback.

layer2.mapping: Motion constraint is encoded into GSE's UI state machine as a timing kernel for smooth interpolation.
layer2.telemetry: Average deviation from target position during UI animation.
